graphName: SheetDB Bulk Delete Operation Knowledge Graph
description: Chronological control flow, data flow, and dependency associations involved in a bulk deletion operation (deleteMany) within SheetDB ORM.

nodes.label: DynamicRepository.deleteMany(ids, options)
nodes.description: Entry point for deleting multiple records. Deduplicates input IDs, resolves batch constraints, and triggers final physical deletion of parents.

nodes.label: DynamicRepository.enforceDeleteConstraintsBatch(ids, options)
nodes.description: Orchestrates batch validations, updates, and deletes topologically. Implements soft-filtering, pre-loading, global key aggregation, topological bulk execution, and surgical rollback.

nodes.label: PrimaryKeyCache.get(tableName)
nodes.description: Retrieves the set of active primary keys for the table in O(1) time. Used in Stage 1 to check pre-existence of input parent IDs.

nodes.label: loadedTables
nodes.description: In-memory database map holding pre-loaded raw rows from target tables. Bypasses the spreadsheet network latency by reducing reads to exactly 1 query per table.

nodes.label: DynamicGraphBuilder.build(table, id, record)
nodes.description: Hydrates a dynamic graph for an individual record using the pre-loaded tables via an in-memory query delegate callback.

nodes.label: globalDeleteNodeKeys
nodes.description: Aggregated union Set containing all slated cascade deletion keys across all individual parent graphs, preventing false-positive protect checks on shared children.

nodes.label: DeletionValidationRegistry.validate(graph, table, id, globalKeys)
nodes.description: Validates constraints on a graph using registered strategies, matching keys against globalDeleteNodeKeys if provided to support overlapping batch checks.

nodes.label: updatesByTable
nodes.description: Aggregated set_null updates mapped by child table. Grouped to perform bulk updates per table in exactly 1 operation.

nodes.label: deleteIdsByTable
nodes.description: Aggregated cascade delete IDs mapped by child table. Grouped to perform bulk deletions per table bottom-up.

nodes.label: sortedTables
nodes.description: Descendant tables sorted in reverse topological order (leaves first, parents last) to ensure cascading deletions execute without violating database constraints.

nodes.label: TableGateway.updateMany(updatesMap)
nodes.description: Performs bulk spreadsheet row updates. Invoked in Stage 4 to set child foreign keys (and polymorphic discriminators) to null.

nodes.label: TableGateway.deleteMany(ids)
nodes.description: Performs bulk spreadsheet row deletions. Invoked in Stage 5 to delete cascading child rows and parent root rows.

nodes.label: _rollbackBatchDeletion(loadedTables, graphs, parentIds)
nodes.description: Surgical transaction rollback handler. Converts cloned graph backups back to raw rows, executing topological re-insertions (parents first) and update restorations on failure.

nodes.label: TableGateway.insertBatch(dataArray)
nodes.description: Performs bulk row insertions. Used during rollback (Stage 6) to re-insert deleted rows topologically with original primary keys.

edges.description: Triggers batch validation and child mutation preprocessing for all parent IDs.
Checks pre-existence of input parent IDs in Stage 1 to separate valid IDs from skipped IDs.
Pre-loads raw rows from target tables in a single read call per table in Stage 2.
Hydrates individual dynamic graphs for valid root records using the loadedTables cache.
Pre-scans all individual graphs to compile the union set of all slated cascade delete keys in Stage 3a.
Invokes validation on each dynamic graph in memory, passing globalDeleteNodeKeys as a parameter.
Evaluates protect and cascade checks against globalDeleteNodeKeys to prevent false-positive blocks on shared child records.
Collects all child records needing nullification into updatesByTable in Stage 4.
Collects all child record IDs slated for cascading delete into deleteIdsByTable in Stage 5.
Sorts mutated tables in reverse topological order (leaves first) to prepare for cascade deletions.
Applies Stage 4 bulk set_null updates to child tables in memory/sheets.
Deletes cascading child rows topologically in Stage 5.
Physically deletes the parent root rows at the end of execution.
Invokes rollback handler to restore sheet data if any update/delete call throws an exception.
Re-inserts deleted records topologically (parents first) using graph backups.
Restores nullified foreign key relationships to their original pre-deletion values.
